title: rubus koehleri var. lignicensis
intro: Rubus koehleri var. lignicensis, commonly known as Chinese Wineberry, is a type of raspberry native to China. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cardiovascular disease, cancer, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rubus koehleri var. lignicensis include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve lipid profiles, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
